Sent from my iPhone
Note to the team: Name matches. Now the full status, warehouse, returns and comms.

Hi Chris,

I'm sorry. Your B30 has missed its November 14 date, and we didn't write to tell you.

Order Shop···· is paid and holds a Harlo B30 and a Power K.. Neither has shipped yet. Your Power K. is already set aside at our Tennessee warehouse. The first B30s have reached that warehouse and started shipping, oldest orders first. Your B30 is now set to ship by November 30, with the Power K. in the same box. You'll get tracking by email as soon as it leaves.

You can follow the B30 shipments on their way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Our last message about this order was on September 15. That was an email from (email hidden) plus a text, saying your batch would ship the week of November 14 and adding the free Power K.. Some of our emails have been going to junk folders, so please check there. It also helps to add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so the tracking email reaches you.

Sarah
